{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", trial_df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check how many rows per patient_id
patient_counts = trial_df['patient_id'].value_counts()
print("Patient row counts:", patient_counts.value_counts())

# Check the sample_seq to see if higher values are the latest
print("Highest sample_seq per patient:", trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts())

# Look at the severity column
print("Severity value counts:", trial_df['severity'].value_counts())"}
